method: AI-assisted reading of official HKBU pages; no independent human review or live application-portal check

schoolPage.recurringWindow: Mid-November through June with an early-closure/rolling warning
schoolPage.partTimeRestriction: School fee table describes part-time as local Hong Kong students only
schoolPage.academicDifference: Registry asks for an honours bachelor degree; school text says bachelor degree without an honours qualifier
schoolPage.languageDifference: Admission section requests English scores where needed; FAQ wording says proof is not a necessary admissions condition

communication.decision: Use the registry's explicit 2027 dates and programme-total fee, not the undated school's recurring months or annual-price conversion. Add existing category contexts only for full-time. Keep part-time deadline null and mode/status applicability mandatory/manual; never fabricate a non-local part-time category merely to satisfy a schema.

requirements.documents: 500-word English essay on academic interests/objectives; own publication/research sample if available
requirements.experience: Relevant professional experience is advantageous, without mandatory years
requirements.selection: Shortlisted interview may be required; Interactive Media concentration selection does not guarantee a concentration place

window.appliesTo: Local and non-local on the programme admissions page

business.payment: Two instalments; not two copies of the programme fee
business.excludedCosts: Business Field Study travel, visa and living costs; textbooks and other course materials

requirements.degree: Recognised bachelor degree or accepted equivalent professional qualification
requirements.documents: Personal statement no more than 500 words; two referees; relevant qualification/score evidence

business.decision: Withhold a default numeric tuition and bind both published category prices to the existing full-time option. Preserve the programme-specific IELTS 6.0 with a mandatory general-versus-specific policy warning rather than silently imposing 6.5 or claiming full eligibility. No scholarship is deducted or universal all-in cost calculated.

shared.validityAnchor: Within two years at issuance of the admission offer, not two years measured from today's date
shared.newToeflScaleDecision: No updated 1-6 threshold was found in consulted programme/general pages; do not infer a conversion from 79/120
shared.waiver: English-medium first degree evidence needs university confirmation, not an automatic waiver
shared.confirmationFee: Registry says confirmation includes the first tuition instalment plus administrative charges; do not count the tuition part twice
shared.classification: HKBU decides local/non-local classification; location in Singapore, nationality or GPA is not used to infer it
shared.partTimeConflict: General non-local information discusses appropriately authorised part-time students, but does not establish that this specific MA accepts them; keep programme-specific uncertainty
